summary.intent: Fix a verifier shortfall miscalculation (34,800 vs 6,800) in the Ask Soony hackathon app without waiting for a sleeping teammate (Farhan), then design a calm 'Sunday flow' on the canvas and rebuild the app's front end around it.
summary.outcome: Verifier fix was delegated to an agent (with a note for Farhan); the Sunday flow (5 phone screens plus desktop) was published to the canvas and approved; a builder agent was launched to rebuild the front end as a 'Today' flow; push and Teams wording was calmed and emoji removed, with changes to cardtools.py committed.

repo: The verifier doesn't count deliveries arriving before the end of packing, which caused the shortfall to be computed as 34,800 instead of 6,800.
Backend functions (paper check, anchoring, routines, voice, push, Teams) are kept intact while the front end is rebuilt.
Design canvas files live in ask-soony/data/design/project/ (canvas.json plus Sunday-N-*.dc.html artboards).
Push and Teams notification wording is in the push test endpoint and related code; the Teams header spans multiple lines, so a simple single-line replacement missed it.
workflow: When a teammate is unavailable, fix issues at the root minimally and leave a note for them rather than blocking.
Assigning a single builder agent to the whole front end avoids conflicts from multiple agents editing the same files.
Multi-line strings need explicit handling in scripted replacements; verify after replacing (grep for leftover emoji) and run tests before committing.
